footprints.description: ECS 1.5 x 5.1 mm cylinder crystal (ECS-1X5X), 2 leads, 0.45 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: ECS-3X8X/2X6X/1X5X dimensions, Fig 3 ECS-1X5X (ECS-3x8X-2x6X-1X5X.pdf p.1): body dia 1.5 max, lead dia 0.2, lead spacing 0.45. Datasheet gives lead spacing and lead diameter, no PCB land pattern: R8 radial, span = lead spacing. R8 pad (hole + 0.6) would overlap at this spacing, so pad = span - 0.1 (round, 0.1 mm copper gap), drill = min(lead + 0.3, pad - 0.2), at least lead + 0.05. Body = round can seen from above (upright mount). Arithmetic: pad 0.45 - 0.1 = 0.35; drill min(0.2 + 0.3 = 0.5, 0.35 - 0.2 = 0.15) = 0.15 < lead + 0.05 -> 0.25 (ring 0.05). Leads must be bent apart to use standard holes.

footprints.description: Abracon AB26T 2.1 x 6.2 mm cylinder crystal, 2 leads, 0.8 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: Abracon AB26T outline drawing (AB26T.pdf p.1): body dia 2.1 max (0.083 in), lead dia 0.26 (0.010 in), lead spacing 0.8 (0.031 in). Datasheet gives lead spacing and lead diameter, no PCB land pattern: R8 radial, span = lead spacing. R8 pad (hole + 0.6) would overlap at this spacing, so pad = span - 0.1 (round, 0.1 mm copper gap), drill = min(lead + 0.3, pad - 0.2), at least lead + 0.05. Body = round can seen from above (upright mount). Arithmetic: pad 0.8 - 0.1 = 0.7; drill min(0.26 + 0.3 = 0.56, 0.7 - 0.2 = 0.5) = 0.5.

footprints.note: ECS-3X8X/2X6X/1X5X dimensions, Fig 2 ECS-2X6X (ECS-3x8X-2x6X-1X5X.pdf p.1; same drawing in CDX-1038.pdf p.1 and ecs-31x.pdf p.1): body dia 2.1 max, lead dia 0.26, lead spacing 0.7. Datasheet gives lead spacing and lead diameter, no PCB land pattern: R8 radial, span = lead spacing. R8 pad (hole + 0.6) would overlap at this spacing, so pad = span - 0.1 (round, 0.1 mm copper gap), drill = min(lead + 0.3, pad - 0.2), at least lead + 0.05. Body = round can seen from above (upright mount). Arithmetic: pad 0.7 - 0.1 = 0.6; drill min(0.26 + 0.3 = 0.56, 0.6 - 0.2 = 0.4) = 0.4.

footprints.description: ECS 3.2 x 10.5 / 3.2 x 9 mm cylinder crystal (ECS-3X10X, 3X9X), 2 leads, 1.1 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: ECS-3X10X / 3X9X Fig 1 and 2 (ECS-3x10X-3x9X.pdf p.1): body dia 3.2 max, lead dia 0.32, lead spacing 1.1; both figures identical in the pad data, so shared by the 3X9 line. Datasheet gives lead spacing and lead diameter, no PCB land pattern: R8 radial, span = lead spacing. R8 pad (hole + 0.6) would overlap at this spacing, so pad = span - 0.1 (round, 0.1 mm copper gap), drill = min(lead + 0.3, pad - 0.2), at least lead + 0.05. Body = round can seen from above (upright mount). Arithmetic (hand check): pad 1.1 - 0.1 = 1.0; drill min(0.32 + 0.3 = 0.62, 1.0 - 0.2 = 0.8) = 0.62; pad centres +-0.55 -> span 1.1; ring (1.0 - 0.62)/2 = 0.19.

footprints.description: Abracon AB308 / AB38T 3.0-3.2 x 8-8.3 mm cylinder crystal, 2 leads, 0.8 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: AB308 outline (ab308.pdf p.2): body dia 3.0 +-0.1, lead dia 0.32 +-0.05, lead spacing 0.8 +-0.2. AB38T outline (AB38T.pdf p.2): body dia 3.2 max, lead dia 0.34 +-0.2 (mid 0.34), lead spacing D 0.8 +-0.3. Same nominal pads -> one footprint for both; body = the larger (3.2). Datasheet gives lead spacing and lead diameter, no PCB land pattern: R8 radial, span = lead spacing. R8 pad (hole + 0.6) would overlap at this spacing, so pad = span - 0.1 (round, 0.1 mm copper gap), drill = min(lead + 0.3, pad - 0.2), at least lead + 0.05. Body = round can seen from above (upright mount). Arithmetic: pad 0.8 - 0.1 = 0.7; drill min(0.32 + 0.3 = 0.62 / 0.34 + 0.3 = 0.64, 0.7 - 0.2 = 0.5) = 0.5. (AB38T lead max 0.54 would not enter a 0.5 hole: bend or trim.)

footprints.description: ECS 3.1 x 8.2 mm cylinder crystal (ECS-3X8X), 2 leads, 1.1 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: ECS-3X8X Fig 1 (ECS-3x8X-2x6X-1X5X.pdf p.1; also ECS-.327-12.5-8X-C.pdf p.1): body dia 3.1 max, lead dia 0.35, lead spacing 1.1. Datasheet gives lead spacing and lead diameter, no PCB land pattern: R8 radial, span = lead spacing. R8 pad (hole + 0.6) would overlap at this spacing, so pad = span - 0.1 (round, 0.1 mm copper gap), drill = min(lead + 0.3, pad - 0.2), at least lead + 0.05. Body = round can seen from above (upright mount). Arithmetic: pad 1.1 - 0.1 = 1.0; drill min(0.35 + 0.3 = 0.65, 1.0 - 0.2 = 0.8) = 0.65; ring 0.175.

footprints.description: ECS HC-46/X crystal, 6.6 x 4.0 mm can, 2 leads, 2.5 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: ECS HC-46X dimensions (HC-46X.pdf p.1): bottom view body 6.6 typ x 4.0 max, lead spacing 2.5 +-0.2 (mid 2.5), lead dia 0.34 +-0.02 (mid 0.34). No land pattern printed: R8 hole = lead + 0.3 = 0.64, pad = hole + 0.6 = 1.24 (round); 2.5 - 1.24 = 1.26 mm between pads.

footprints.description: Abracon HC-49/U and HC-49/US crystal, 11.5 x 5.0 mm can, 2 leads, 4.88 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: Abracon HC49/U outline (ab.pdf p.3) and ABL HC49/US mechanical dimensions (ABL.pdf p.4; identical lead data): body 0.453 in (11.5) x 0.20 in (5.0) max, lead dia 0.018 in (0.457), lead spacing 0.192 +-0.008 in (4.88 +-0.20, mid 4.88). No land pattern printed: R8 hole = 0.457 + 0.3 = 0.757 -> 0.76, pad = 0.76 + 0.6 = 1.36 (round); 4.88 - 1.36 = 3.52 mm between pads. Shared by the HC-49/US line (same pads).

footprints.description: ECS HC-49/U, HC-49/US and HC-49/USS crystal, 11.35 x 4.65-5.0 mm can, 2 leads, 4.88 mm lead spacing
footprints.note: ECS HC-49UX (HC-49UX.pdf p.1; hc49u.pdf p.1; ECS-10-13-1XH.pdf p.1), HC-49USX(-DN) (hc-49usx-dn.pdf p.1, hc-49usx.pdf p.1, hc_49us.pdf p.1), HC-49USSX (HC-49USS.pdf p.1): lead spacing 4.88, lead dia 0.43, body 11.35 max x 4.65 max (U, US) or x 5.0 max (USS). All the same pads -> one footprint; body = the largest, 11.35 x 5.0. No land pattern printed: R8 hole = 0.43 + 0.3 = 0.73, pad = 0.73 + 0.6 = 1.33 (round); 4.88 - 1.33 = 3.55 mm between pads. Pad 2 of a 3rd-in-line-lead option is not drawn (pinouts have 2 pins).

footprints.description: 3-terminal ceramic resonator, 2.5 x 2.0 mm body: three 0.5 x 0.8 pads at each end of the terminals, 1.0 mm pitch, pins 1-3 left to right (a pad at the top and the bottom of each)
footprints.note: Abracon AWSCR-CW 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/AWSCR_CW.pdf p.2): pad width 0.5, pitch 1.0, pad centre lines 2.0+-0.2 apart; that drawing gives no pad length, 0.8 taken from the identical ECS-HFR-B Figure 2 land pattern (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ecs_HFR_B.pdf p.1: 0.5 wide, 0.8 long, centres 2.0 apart, 1.0 pitch). Hand check: x = -1.0, 0, +1.0 (pitch 1.0); y = +-2.0/2 = +-1.0; each pad 0.5 x 0.8 spans y 0.6..1.4 (body edge at 1.0, pad runs 0.4 past it and 0.4 under it); pad gap in x = 1.0-0.5 = 0.5 (matches the drawing's 0.5 gaps, overall 3x0.5+2x0.5 = 2.5). Each pin has two pads (top and bottom), the terminal runs under the body between them. Pin numbering 1-2-3 left to right as the datasheet's pin table (1 X1/In, 2 GND, 3 X2/Out). Body 2.5 x 2.0.

footprints.description: 3-terminal ceramic resonator, 3.2 x 1.3 mm body: three 0.4 x 2.0 pads, 1.2 mm pitch
footprints.note: Abracon AWSCR-CELA 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/AWSCR-CELA.pdf p.4; AWSCR-CELB.pdf p.4 is the same drawing); equal to ECS-CTE Figure 2 Suggested Land Pattern (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ECS-CTE.pdf p.1). Hand check: pads 0.4 wide x 2.0 (+-0.2) long, centres 1.2 apart -> x = -1.2, 0, +1.2; gap = 1.2-0.4 = 0.8; outer edge = 1.2+0.2 = 1.4 < body half 1.6 (terminals 0.4 wide at 1.2 pitch with 0.4 from the end, outline: 1.2+0.2+0.2 = 1.6 ok). Pad length 2.0 vs body height 1.3: 0.35 past the body each side. Pins 1 Input, 2 Ground, 3 Output left to right.

footprints.description: 2-terminal ceramic resonator, 3.7 x 3.1 mm body: two 0.7 x 4.1 pads, centres 3.0 mm apart
footprints.note: Abracon AWSZT-CV 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/AWSZT-CV.pdf p.2): 0.7 wide, 4.1 long, 3.0 between the pad centre lines; equal to ECS-CR2-A Figure 2 / table T1 3.0, T2 0.7, W1 4.1 (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ecs_cr2_a.pdf p.1). Hand check: span 3.0 centre to centre -> x = -1.5, +1.5; pad 0.7 x 4.1 spans x 1.15..1.85, i.e. exactly the 0.7 terminal at the end of the 3.7 body (3.7/2 = 1.85; 1.85-0.7 = 1.15); inner gap 3.0-0.7 = 2.3. Pad 1 left, pad 2 right.

footprints.description: 3-terminal ceramic resonator, 3.7 x 3.1 mm body: 0.7 x 4.1 outer pads, 1.0 x 4.1 middle pad, 1.5 mm pitch
footprints.note: Abracon AWSCR-CV 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/AWSCR_CV.pdf p.2: 0.7 outer, 1.0 middle, 1.5 centre to centre, 4.1 long); equal to ECS-CR2-B Figure 3 / table T1 1.0 (middle width), T2 0.7 (outer width), T3 1.5 (pitch), W1 4.1 (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ecs_cr2_b.pdf p.1). Hand check: outer pads x = +-1.5, 0.7 wide -> span 1.15..1.85 = body edge 3.7/2 = 1.85 minus the 0.7 terminal; middle pad 1.0 wide -> -0.5..0.5; gap between pads = 1.15-0.5 = 0.65. Pins 1, 2 (ground), 3 left to right. The drawings are not to scale (the Abracon outer pads are drawn wider); the printed dimensions are used.

footprints.description: 3-terminal ceramic resonator, 4.5 x 2.0 mm body: three 0.8 x 2.6 pads, 1.5 mm pitch
footprints.note: Abracon AWSCR-CRLA 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/AWSCR-CRLA.pdf p.4): 0.8 wide, 2.6 (+-0.2) long, 1.5 pitch. Terminals per the outline (p.3): 0.8 wide, 1.5 pitch, 0.75 from the end (terminal centre 1.5 + 0.75 = 2.25 = 4.5/2 body edge, so the terminal runs 1.1..1.9 from the centre). Pad length 2.6 vs body height 2.0: 0.3 past the body each side. Pins 1 Input, 2 Ground, 3 Output left to right.

footprints.description: 3-terminal ceramic resonator, 4.7 x 4.1 mm body: 0.8 x 5.1 outer pads, 1.3 x 5.1 middle pad, 1.95 mm pitch
footprints.note: Abracon AWSCR-MT 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/N_AWSCR-MT.pdf p.3; the datasheet is stamped EOL): outer pads 0.8, middle pad 1.3, 5.1 long, 1.95 between the middle pad centre and each outer pad centre (the outline's 1.95 is the same pitch: 1.95 + 0.8/2 = 2.35 = 4.7/2). The drawing is not to scale; the printed dimensions are used (1.3 read as the middle pad width, the arrow spans the middle pad). Hand check: x = -1.95, 0, +1.95; outer pads span 1.55..2.35, middle -0.65..0.65, gap 1.55-0.65 = 0.9. Pins 1 Input, 2 Ground, 3 Output left to right.

footprints.description: 2-terminal ceramic resonator, 6.0 x 3.0 mm body: two 1.7 x 4.0 pads, centres 5.0 mm apart
footprints.note: ECS-CTA Figure 2 Suggested Land Pattern (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ECS-CTA.pdf p.1): pads 1.7 (+-0.3) wide, 4.0 (+-0.3) long, 5.0 (+-0.6) between the pad centre lines (the dimension arrow runs between the dash-dot centre lines). Hand check: x = +-5.0/2 = +-2.5; pad spans 1.65..3.35: the 1.2 terminal at the body end is 1.8..3.0, so the pad is 0.15 longer than the terminal on the inside and 0.35 on the outside. Pad 1 left, pad 2 right.

footprints.description: 3-terminal ceramic resonator, 6.0 x 3.0 mm body: 1.7 x 4.0 outer pads, 1.5 x 4.0 middle pad, 2.5 mm pitch
footprints.note: Abracon AWSCR-CPLA 'Recommended Land Pattern' (datasheets/crystal/abracon/AWSCR-CPLA.pdf p.3; AWSCR-CPLB.pdf p.4 is the same drawing): outer pads 1.7, middle pad 1.5, 4.0 long, 2.5 pitch; equal to ECS-CTP Figure 2 (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ECS-CTP.pdf p.1). Hand check: x = -2.5, 0, +2.5; outer pads span 1.65..3.35 (the 1.2 terminal at the body end is 1.8..3.0), middle -0.75..0.75, gap 1.65-0.75 = 0.9. Pins 1 Input, 2 Ground, 3 Output left to right.
